name: Starbucks Egg White & Roasted Red Pepper Sous Vide Bites
whyItWorks: Cooked sous-vide in a vacuum pouch to achieve a silken, custard-like texture that melts in the mouth without chewing effort. High in protein (12g) and low in fat, with sweet tender roasted red peppers that lack harsh skins.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for them warmed. Consume slowly with herbal tea or water.
